strings.en: There is a rack for weapons.
strings.tl: There is a rack for weapons.

strings.jp: 武器を並べる台がある。

strings.tl: There is a rack for weapons.

strings.jp:
武器を並べておく台だな。
なんにもないけど。
strings.read:
武器を並べておく台だな。
なんにもないけど。
strings.en:
It's a rack for holding weapons. There's
nothing on it, though.
strings.tl: It's a rack for holding weapons. There's nothing on it, though.

strings.jp:
武器を並べておく台だよ。
でも、並んでいる武器が少ないのは
残念だね。
{e0be}{e0d9}一杯に並ぶと{e0db}観なんだけどな。
strings.read:
武器を並べておく台だよ。
でも、並んでいる武器が少ないのは
残念だね。
部屋一杯に並ぶと壮観なんだけどな。
strings.en:
It's a rack for holding weapons. But it's
a shame there are so few on it. It's a
magnificent sight when they fill a
whole room.
strings.tl: It's a rack for holding weapons. But it's a shame there are so few on it. It's a magnificent sight when they fill a whole room.

strings.jp: これを調べて何か意味があるのか?
strings.read: これを調べて何か意味があるのか?
strings.en: Is there any point in examining this?
strings.tl: Is there any point in examining this?

strings.jp:
武器を並べておく台ですね。
{e0dd}庫はいつも少ないようですが。
strings.read:
武器を並べておく台ですね。
在庫はいつも少ないようですが。
strings.en:
It is a rack for holding weapons. Though
the stock always seems to be low.
strings.tl: It is a rack for holding weapons. Though the stock always seems to be low.

strings.jp:
武器を{e09a}る台だろ。
この{e0be}{e0d9}に必要とは思えねえけどな。
strings.read:
武器を飾る台だろ。
この部屋に必要とは思えねえけどな。
strings.en:
It's a rack for displaying weapons. Can't
see why this room needs one, though.
strings.tl: It's a rack for displaying weapons. Can't see why this room needs one, though.

武器を並べておく台だよね。

strings.en:
It's a rack for holding weapons, right?
Store them the wrong way and they get
a weird bend in them, you know!
strings.tl: It's a rack for holding weapons, right? Store them the wrong way and they get a weird bend in them, you know!

It is a rack for displaying weapons. It
appears to be tremendously useful.
strings.tl: It is a rack for displaying weapons. It appears to be tremendously useful.
